# Generated Sony ARW metadata fixtures

These tiny files are original classic-TIFF containers with synthetic Sony
metadata. They contain no sensor image or embedded photograph, and must never
be presented as decodable camera captures. All bytes were generated by this
project under its MIT license; no third-party photographic content is included.

Regenerate from the repository root:

```sh
python3 scripts/make_arw_fixtures.py
```

- `sony-le.ARW` / `sony-be.arw`: equivalent little/big-endian standard TIFF,
  EXIF, GPS, and CFA SubIFD metadata; primary dimensions describe a small preview.
- `missing.arw`: Sony make only; other fields must remain unavailable.
- `raw-dimensions.arw`: no EXIF pixel dimensions; use the CFA SubIFD dimensions.

Tests mutate these containers in temporary directories for malformed offsets,
truncation, cyclic links, invalid fields, and bounded-resource checks. An
optional real camera file may be supplied through `PHOTOC_ARW_REAL_FIXTURE`;
this private file is never committed or developed.
